translations.complianceReview.subtitle: Measured results and missing evidence, in one place.
translations.complianceReview.scoreNote: Unknown and not-applicable results are excluded, not passed.
translations.complianceReview.unknownHint: Evidence is unavailable or insufficient. It cannot establish a pass or a failure.
translations.complianceReview.notApplicableHint: Excluded only when a documented applicability decision supports it.
translations.complianceReview.scope: Mapped technical checks only, not full-framework certification. Scores describe assessed controls; coverage shows what remains unknown.
translations.complianceReview.requiredRule: A missing result is not a failed requirement. A mandatory activity is a failure only when applicability and non-performance are evidenced.
translations.complianceReview.legacy: This response predates structured evidence. Its server-reported status is retained; check-level evidence is unavailable.
translations.complianceReview.name: Control
translations.complianceReview.noChecks: No structured check evidence was supplied.
translations.complianceReview.missingFramework: This framework is not in the current assessment.
translations.complianceReview.missingControl: This control is not in the current assessment.
translations.complianceReview.emptyHint: Connect evidence sources or complete a supported scan to populate mapped technical checks.
translations.complianceReview.loadFailed: Compliance evidence could not be loaded.
